description: Unleashes the power of the Labyrinth to empower the caster with new abilities. Lasts 30s.  Duration is reduced when Havoc Form special abilities are used.  FIRE: Blasts Lightning Tendrils from the Archon's hand  dealing 48 SHOCK Damage every 0.35s second to targets within 15m.  AIM: Raises a 3m Energy Shield which reduces incoming damage to all allies by 50%.  DODGE: Performs a Blink Evade that deals 150 SHOCK damage to enemies within 5m.

name: Healing Shield
description: The Medic quickly expels healing energy to SHIELD all allies within 25m for 100% of their Max Health for 10s. While shielded  allies regenerate 20% of their Max Health over the duration.

name: Heavy Weapon: Flamethrower
description: PRESS: Deploys a Flamethrower Turret which lasts until its Ammo is exhausted. Turrets that can aim will prioritize targets that the player Aims at. Press SKILL again to enable autonomous targeting.  HOLD: Deploys to Heavy Carry Mode. If Engineer Prime is available  will Overclock the weapon if already in hand or on the battlefield.  DOUBLE PRESS: The weapon is reclaimed  returning 75% of its remaining Ammo.  Heavy Weapon Ammo is regenerated by 1.02% every second  and Heavy Weapons can only be deployed if at least 25% Ammo is available.

name: Heavy Weapon: Impact Cannon
description: PRESS: Deploys a Impact Cannon Turret which lasts until its Ammo is exhausted. Turrets that can aim will prioritize targets that the player Aims at. Press SKILL again to enable autonomous targeting.  HOLD: Deploys to Heavy Carry Mode. If Engineer Prime is available  will Overclock the weapon if already in hand or on the battlefield.  DOUBLE PRESS: The weapon is reclaimed  returning 75% of its remaining Ammo.  Heavy Weapon Ammo is regenerated by 1.02% every second  and Heavy Weapons can only be deployed if at least 25% Ammo is available.

name: Heavy Weapon: Vulcan
description: PRESS: Deploys a Vulcan Cannon Turret which lasts until its Ammo is exhausted. Turrets that can aim will prioritize targets that the player Aims at. Press SKILL again to enable autonomous targeting.  HOLD: Deploys to Heavy Carry Mode. If Engineer Prime is available  will Overclock the weapon if already in hand or on the battlefield.  DOUBLE PRESS: The weapon is reclaimed  returning 75% of its remaining Ammo.  Heavy Weapon Ammo is regenerated by 1.02% every second  and Heavy Weapons can only be deployed if at least 25% Ammo is available.

name: Hunter's Focus
description: Continuously Aiming Down Sights uninterrupted and without shooting for 0.5s causes the Hunter to enter a FOCUSED state. Wears off after 0.75s of leaving Aim. Lasts 25s.  FOCUSED reduces Weapon Spread  Recoil  and Sway by 50% and grants 25% Ranged & Ranged Weakspot Damage.  While FOCUSED  Aiming at enemies will automatically apply MARK.  FOCUSED state can last up to 10s after the Skill duration expires.  MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Increases the Hunter's spatial awareness by casting an Aura that automatically applies MARK to all enemies within 35m. While senses are heightened  Hunter also gains 15% increased Ranged and Melee damage. Lasts 25s.  MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

name: Hunter's Shroud
description: Hunter becomes Shrouded  reducing enemy awareness and making them harder to hit while moving. Attacking or activating a Mod or Skill will instantly exit Shroud.  Exiting Shroud applies MARK to all enemies within 10m and grants AMBUSH to the Hunter for 2s.  AMBUSH: Increases Ranged and Melee Damage by 50% which diminishes over its duration. Ranged and Melee attacks apply MARK.  Hunter will automatically Shroud again after 1.15s if no offensive actions are performed.  Lasts 15s.  MARK: Crit Chance against MARKED enemies is increased by 10% for all allies.

name: Juggernaut
description: Become nearly unstoppable  gaining 3 Stacks of BULWARK  15% Movement  Melee Speed  and Reduced Stamina Cost. Increases Melee damage by 50%. Stagger Level reduced by 1. Lasts 25s.

name: Miasma
description: Casts an AOE burst that applies BLEEDING  BURNING  OVERLOADED  and CORRODED to all enemies within 15m  and dealing a total 300 base damage. Lasts 10s.

name: Minion: Flyer
description: Summons a Root Flyer Minion to fight by your side. Costs 10% of Max Health to summon  but will not kill Summoner. Max (2).  HOLD: SACRIFICE Root Flyer Minions  dealing 50 Damage within 3m and spawning 3 homing projectiles which explode on contact for 150 damage each.  Reduces Skill Cooldown by up to 50% based on remaining Health of each Minion Sacrificed.

name: Minion: Hollow
description: PRESS: Summons a Root Hollow Minion to fight by your side. Costs 15% of Max Health to summon  but will not kill Summoner. Max (2).  HOLD: SACRIFICE Root Hollow Minions to explode  dealing 150 damage within 5m. Reduces Skill Cooldown by up to 50% based on remaining Health of each Minion Sacrificed.

name: Minion: Reaver
description: PRESS: Summons a Root Reaver Minion to fight by your side. Costs 35% of Max Health to summon  but will not kill Summoner. Max (1).  HOLD: SACRIFICE Root Reaver Minion  dealing 200 Damage within 6m and spawning Spore Bombs which bounce and explode on contact for 200 damage each.  Reduces Skill Cooldown by up to 50% based on remaining Health of Minion.

name: Plainswalker
description: Increases Movement Speed by 20% and reduces Stamina Cost by 80% for all allies. Lasts 30s.

name: Quick Draw
description: Pull out your trusty side piece and upload up to 6 Critical Shots from the hip. Each shot deals 52 base damage and double stagger value.  PRESS: Instantly fires towards all enemies in view within 25m. Upon release  rounds will be divided evenly among all targets.  HOLD & RELEASE: Allows manual Aim and fires one single powerful shot upon release.

name: Rampage
description: Enters a heightened state of battle which increases Fire Rate by 10%  Reload Speed by 25%  and Movement Speed by 15%. Lasts 10s.  Kills and dealing significant damage grant 1 Stack of RAGE which increases Ranged Damage by 2.5% per Stack. Upon reaching 10 Stacks  the Challenger goes BERSERK  which reloads their current firearm and doubles Rampage effects for 15s.

name: Reality Rune
description: Conjures a 7m protective dome which applies SLOW to any enemy or enemy projectile. Allies inside gain 25% Damage Reduction and automatically generate 50 Mod Power per second. Lasts 15s.

name: Reboot
description: Initiates a Data Backup of the caster's current Health  Stamina  Relic Charges  Ammo  and Negative Status Effects  which are stored for 30s.  While the Backup is active  increases Movement Speed by 15% and Damage Reduction by 10%.  Reactivating the Skill restores all saved values from the Backup and spawns a Decoy which lasts 3s.

name: Redemption
description: The Medic unleashes a 30m shockwave that revives downed allies and restores 50% Max Health over 10s. For each additional 1s holding the SKILL button  the heal gains an additional 50% (up to 200% max).  Revived allies will only receive 50% of the healing amount. If revived  allies cannot be revived again by Redemption for another 180s. Resets at Worldstone or on death.

name: Sidewinder
description: Calls upon the power of the Desert Sidewinder snake to increase ADS Movement Speed by 50% and Draw/Swap Speed by 35%. Cycling weapons will automatically reload incoming Firearms. When a Weapon Swap provides Ammo to an incoming weapon  Duration is reduced by 6s. Lasts 60s.

name: Support Dog
description: Companion will follow the Handler and continuously heal allies within 3.5m for 0.25% of Max Health per second.  SINGLE PRESS: Companion engages enemies near the targeted location.  DOUBLE TAP: Companion returns to the Handler and remains by their side.  HOLD: Howl grants 2% of Max Health per second and 25% increased Movement Speed to all allies within 20m. Lasts 25s.

name: Vial: Elixir of Life
description: Creates a mysterious vapor cloud which lasts 10s and applies LIVING WILL.  LIVING WILL grants 5 Health Regeneration per second  and protects against fatal damage. Can revive downed players. Lasts 20s.  Revived allies cannot be affected by Living Will for 180s. Resets at Worldstone or on death.  PRESS: Slam Vial on the ground  creating the effect at the Alchemist's feet.  HOLD & RELEASE: Aim and throw the Vial causing the same effect where it lands.

name: Vial: Frenzy Dust
description: Creates a mysterious vapor cloud which lasts 10s and applies FRENZIED.  FRENZIED increases Fire Rate  Reload Speed  and Melee Speed by 20%  and Movement Speed by 15%. Lasts 15s.  PRESS: Slam Vial on the ground  creating the effect at the Alchemist's feet.  HOLD & RELEASE: Aim and throw the Vial causing the same effect where it lands.

name: Vial: Stone Mist
description: Creates a mysterious vapor cloud which lasts 10s and applies STONESKIN.  STONESKIN reduces incoming damage by 25%  reduces Stagger by 1  greatly increases Blight Buildup Decay Rate  and makes the target immune to STATUS Effects. Lasts 15s.  PRESS: Slam Vial on the ground  creating the effect at the Alchemist's feet.  HOLD & RELEASE: Aim and throw the Vial causing the same effect where it lands.

name: Void Cloak
description: Automatically Perfect Dodge incoming direct damage for 60s. Each auto-evade reduces timer by 33% - 100% based on damage absorbed and spawns a Decoy for 3s.

name: War Stomp
description: Creates a high-impact tremor that deals 150 damage and additional stagger in a forward cone up to 7.5m. Deals damage in all directions at point blank range.

name: Way of Kaeula
description: Invoke Kaeula to cast a Tidal Wave  dealing 150 Elemental damage and conjuring a 30m Rainstorm for 15s. Allies inside Rainstorm gain HASTE. Enemies inside Rainstorm gain DRENCHED for 10s.  DRENCHED: Reduces Movement Speed by 10%. Every few seconds  lightning strikes enemies dealing 300 base SHOCK damage split among DRENCHED targets.

name: Way of Lydusa
description: Invoke Lydusa to infuse Ranged and Melee Damage with the power to apply BRITTLE  allowing the Invoker to generate Sand Devils through damage or kills. Lasts 15s  Reactivating the skill consumes all Sand Devils generated and casts a 15m Sand Blast dealing 100 Elemental Damage per charge. Max 10 charges.  BRITTLE: Increases incoming Critical Chance by 10% and Critical Damage by 15%.

name: Way of Meidra
description: Invoke Meidra to heal all allies for 20% Max Health over 1.5s and conjure a 20m Forest Growth for 15s. After fully blooming  allies in the Forest Growth heal 2% Max Health per second and gain 3% of base damage dealt as Lifesteal. Enemies inside Forest Growth gain GLOOM for 10s.  GLOOM: Increases incoming Elemental damage by 15%.  Cooldown: 120s.

name: Wellspring
description: The Medic channels healing energy into their fist  punching a hole into the ground to create a 3m Healing Spring AOE which restores 10 Health per second and greatly increases Blight Decay Rate. Lasts 15s.

name: Worm Hole
description: Warps the caster forward through space-time. The next Melee or Ranged attack within 5s will deal 300% increased damage. Counts as a Perfect Dodge.  Holding the Skill button will show the targeting device. If an enemy is directly targeted  the caster will emerge behind them.

name: Academic's Overcoat
description: Donning this uniform makes you feel a touch smarter  and you can't help but straighten the necktie whenever it slips loose.

name: Bandit Jacket
description: Little more than a coat  stitched together from scraps of leather and whatever else could be scavenged from the wasteland. While it may provide a small degree of protection against the elements  it's hardly suitable for combat and is more of a fashion statement than anything else.

name: Battle Shirt
description: A simple  standard-issue army shirt made from a durable canvas composite. It's seen a lot of action but was clearly carefully maintained. There appears to be some kind of tag above the pocket  but whatever it once said  time washed it away long ago.

name: Bruiser Bodyplate
description: This thing is difficult to put on or take off and makes you feel like a walking tank. In the thick of battle  that's exactly what you're looking for.

name: Crimson Guard Plate
description: This heavy suit of armor encumbers your shoulders with weight befitting the burdens of a sovereign. It emits a faint heat  as if forged from an ever-hot metal.

name: Cultist Duster
description: More symbolic than functional  it's adorned with trinkets and ornaments instead of providing significant protection. The coat's drab color blends in with the bleak  post-apocalyptic landscape  serving as a visible sign of the wearer's allegiance to the Root

name: Dendroid Chest
description: Fibrous tentacles wrap themselves around your chest. Up until now  you've resolutely avoided this situation.

name: Disciple Mantle
description: The pauldrons bear the mirrored faces of Meidra and Kaeula  who always journeyed together in their ethereal wanderings  for Meidra's flowers could not bloom so lovely without Kaeula's rains.

name: Elder Raiment
description: A distinctive piece of protective gear originating from Yaesha. Its vibrant red color and fur adornments make it stand out  serving as a symbol of the wearer's status and skill. While it may not provide as much protection as some other types of armor  its lightweight construction and flexible design allow for exceptional mobility and ease of movement in combat.

name: Fae Royal Bodyplate
description: The royal guard do not wear insignias on their chests nor crests on their shield. It is assumed their identify is clear from their grab and the confidence with which they carry themselves.

name: Field Medic Overcoat
description: A long coat over a plate of armor. The metal could be thicker  sure  but your primary concern is safe and speedy travel to the wounded.

name: High Noon Duds
description: A rugged amalgamation of canvas  denim  leather  and steel. These different materials all serve the same purpose of keeping you covered without inhibiting aiming mobility.

name: Knotted Cage
description: Tightly coiled bark shrouds you like a second ribcage. Its embrace is surprisingly-and frighteningly-comforting.

name: Labyrinth Mantle
description: Though the cloth and tassels possess a seemingly primitive design  the pure energy wracking down your spine reminds you otherwise.

name: Leto Mark 1 Armor
description: An impressive prototype engineered to safeguard against any danger from the Root  but its cutting-edge technology sacrifices agility and mobility in exchange for unparalleled protection

name: Leto Mark II Armor
description: A masterpiece of impenetrability. Even though quick maneuvering is near impossible in this metal behemoth  you can't help but be impressed by the ingenuity of the design and the inspired craftsmanship.

name: Nanoplated Vestments
description: The light-plated design of this armor protects not only flesh  but a[sic] highly advanced artificial nervous system that conducts stellar energy to power the entire suit.  “Risynth Neko's reputation as a Seeker faltered in recent cycles due to a rumor arising about his addiction to ambit ember. His reputation was not the only one damaged during the civil debates regarding N'Erud jump [sic] but it was one of the most momentous.”

name: Nightstalker Garb
description: This old coat is shabby  but who's really looking? The wealth of interior ammunition pockets more than makes up for it.

name: Radiant Protector
description: A dazzling sight  its golden surface featuring a stunning sun burst pattern etched into the chest. Adorned with blue gems embedded in the shoulders this armor is fit for only the most esteemed members of the Laemir

name: Realmwalker Tunic
description: It's not even frayed. How is that possible? Unless the World Stones did the same thing to Ford's clothes as they did to Ford himself.

name: Red Widow Raiment
description: This chest piece must be hundreds -thousands- of years old  yet it shows no signis of rust or decay. One can only imagine a Pan king or queen wearing such  majestic regalia.

name: Space Worker Body
description: It's made of some material you don't recognize - thick but highly pliable  did the Drzyr expect to get struck by out there?

name: Survivor Overcoat
description: A combination of a sturdy metal chest plate and a worn  leather trench coat that provides some protection against the elements. It's clear that the are together with practicality in mind  rather than aesthetics.

name: Technician Bodyplate
description: The Xul were engineers and builders  but this armor was made to withstand a grenade blast. Was this built for safety or something else?

name: Trainer Clothes
description: This isn't just any denim jacket  it's your denim jacket. It's not especial pale. 7 ready  but it's comfortable  and in it you feel ready for anything.

name: Void Carapace
description: Crafted from the same mysterious material as the Void gloves  helm  and greaves  the chest armor completes the set's unsettling aesthetic. Its angular design is both practical and intimidating  providing unparalleled protection against the deadly environments and creatures of Rhom.

name: Zealot's Overcoat
description: This long and tattered cloak is ideal for skulking about in the dead of night in pursuance of iniquitous aims. If you ever see the back of this cloak ahead of you  you would do well to run. If you ever see its wearer facing you  it is already too late.

name: Affliction
description: Increases STATUS EFFECT duration against enemies by 10 -> 100%.  RITUALIST Archetype Trait

name: Ammo Reserves
description: Increases Ammo Reserves by 5% -> 50%.  GUNSLINGER Archetype Trait

name: Amplitude
description: Increases AOE and AURA Size by 5 -> 50%.

name: Arcane Strike
description: Increases Mod Power Generation from Melee Damage by 5 -> 50%.

name: Barkskin
description: Reduces all incoming damage by 1 -> 10%.

name: Barrier
description: Increases SHIELD amount by 1.5% -> 15%.

name: Blood Bond
description: Summoner Minions absorb 1 -> 10% of damage taken by the caster.

name: Bloodstream
description: Increases Grey Health Regeneration by 0.3/s -> 3/s.

name: Chakra
description: Increases Mod Duration by 3 -> 30%.

name: Dark Pact
description: Increases Grey Health Conversion Rate by 3 -> 30%.

name: Endurance
description: Increases Max Stamina by 3 -> 30.

name: Expertise
description: Reduces Skill Cooldowns by 2% -> 20%.

name: Fitness
description: Increases Evade Distance by 3 -> 30%.

name: Flash Caster
description: Increases Mod and Skill Casting Speed by 5 -> 50%.  ARCHON Archetype Trait.

name: Footwork
description: Increases Movement Speed while Aiming by 5 -> 50%.

name: Fortify
description: Increases Armor Effectiveness by 5% -> 50%.  ENGINEER Archetype Trait

name: Gifted
description: Increases Skill Duration by 30%.  INVOKER Archetype Trait

name: Glutton
description: Increases the Use Speed of Consumables and Relics by 3.5% -> 35%.

name: Handling
description: Reduces Weapon Spread and Recoil by 3% -> 30%.

name: Insight
description: Automatically generate 1 Mod Power per second.

name: Kinship
description: Reduces Friendly Fire Damage Dealt and Received by 8% -> 80%.  HANDLER Archetype Trait.

name: Leech
description: Increases Lifesteal Efficacy by 5 -> 50%.

name: Longshot
description: Increases Weapon Ideal Range by 0.6m -> 6m.  HUNTER Archetype Trait

name: Perception
description: Increases HASTE by 0.3 -> 3% and SLOW by 1 -> 10%.

name: Potency
description: Increases Consumable Duration by 10% -> 100%.  ALCHEMIST Archetype Trait.

name: Preservation
description: Increases SHIELD Duration Received 3 -> 30%.

name: Recovery
description: Increases Stamina Regen by 3 -> 30/s.

name: Regrowth
description: Increases Health Regeneration by 0.15/s -> 1.5/s.  SUMMONER Archetype Trait

name: Resolute
description: Reduces Hit Reaction Time by 2.5% -> 25%.

name: Revivalist
description: Increases the speed of Reviving and being Revived by 5 -> 50%.

name: Rugged
description: Increases the Health of Archetype Summons by a 10 -> 100% .

name: Scholar
description: Increases Experience Gain by 1 -> 15%.

name: Shadeskin
description: Increases Elemental Damage Resistance by 2 -> 20%.

name: Siphoner
description: Grants 0.3 -> 3.0% base damage as Lifesteal.

name: Spirit
description: Increases Mod Power Generation by 2% -> 20%.

name: Strong Back
description: Increases Dodge Weight Threshold by 1.5 -> 15.  CHALLENGER Archetype Trait

name: Swiftness
description: Increases Movement Speed by 1% -> 15%.  Increases Environmental Movement Speed by 5% - 50%.  (Vaulting  Ladders  Wading)  EXPLORER Archetype Trait.

name: Triage
description: Increases Healing by 5% -> 50%.  MEDIC Archetype Trait

name: Untouchable
description: Increases Evade Window by 3% -> 30%.  INVADER Archetype Trait

name: Vigor
description: Increases Max Health by 3 -> 30.

name: AS-10 "Bulldog"
description: A brutal drum-fed fully-automatic 10 gauge shotgun designed for close-quarters combat.

name: Abyssal Hook
description: A hammer-like anchor that swings with an exceptionally irregular ferocity.

name: Alpha / Omega
description: Charge shot fires a burst of five energy bolts. Each hit reduces charge time by 0.1s and increases damage by 10% for 1.5s. Stacks 5x.

name: Anguish
description: Fires heated bits of molten slag. Can be charged to fire a single explosive rod at the cost of causing damage to the wielder while charging.

name: Aphelion
description: Fires a hypercharged wide-arching line that passes through targets.

name: Assassin's Dagger
description: Lightweight. Silent. Deadly. It's rumored that the blade is meant to bestow a slow  agonizing death.

name: Atom Smasher
description: A powerful crushing device that harnesses rocket technology to increase smashing force.

name: Atom Splitter
description: A giant tool for splitting heavy rocks.

name: Black Greatsword
description: A massive weapon of pure destruction. Attacks can be enhanced by Charging at the cost of Stamina over time. Increases Encumbrance by 15.

name: Blackmaw AR-47
description: A fully automatic rifle with a medium capacity. Highly effective with controlled bursts.

name: Blade of Gul
description: A short  but thick sword  used by Gul Warriors. Its compact design makes for swift yet hard-hitting blows. An excellent close-range option.

name: Bolt Driver
description: An ingenius Gul rifle designed to harness energy from Pan crystals. Charge to fire a 3-shot burst.

name: Bone Chopper
description: A razor-sharp hand axe. Excellent for separating flesh from bone. Charge for double attacks.

name: Chicago Typewriter
description: A classic Tommy Gun with large ammo capacity and a slow reload. Poor initial accuracy which improves while holding down the trigger.

name: Coach Gun
description: A double-barrel over/under shotgun modified to fire powerful slugs. High damage with a decent fire rate  but very low magazine capacity.

name: Corrupted Aphelion
description: A laser shotgun that fires three hypercharged arc lines that penetrate targets.

name: Corrupted Arbalest
description: Fully automatic mechanisms launch a bouncing Energy Disc that can hit up to 2 enemies in close proximity. Damage is reduced after bouncing.

name: Corrupted Cube Gun
description: Fusion charged auto-cannon generates cubes which penetrate. Infinite ammo capacity. Can overheat. Cannot score Weakspot hits.

name: Corrupted Deceit
description: A pinpoint accurate split-barreled rifle that fires two penetrating rails. High base damage  but cannot score Weakspot hits. Charge to fire.

name: Corrupted Merciless
description: Fires high-powered nails. Limited magazine size.

name: Corrupted Meridian
description: Fires rocket that deals AOE damage within 2m. Charging the weapon can load additional rockets. (Max 3). Cannot Weakspot.

name: Corrupted Nebula
description: Semi-automatic laser weapon. Weakspot hits and kills create a Nano-bot for 8s that seeks enemies within 20m and repeatedly attacks dealing 6 → 18 ACID damage per hit. Max 5 Nano-bots.

name: Corrupted Rune Pistol
description: A pistol infused with erroneous properties. Fires energy  allowing the trigger to be held for continuous fire.

name: Corrupted Savior
description: A Black Crystal weapon which gains increased Fire Rate as Mod Power is generated. Mod power drains after 3s of not dealing damage.

name: Corrupted Sorrow
description: Innately cannot harm allies. Fires bolts which anchor to targets for 6s. Max 10 bolts anchored at once.

name: Crescent Moon
description: An ethereal weapon that seems to resonate.  Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

name: Crossbow
description: An accurate and deadly single-shot crossbow with a low sound profile.

name: Crystal Staff
description: The staff hums with energy. A destructive power within yearns to be released.

name: Cube Gun
description: Projectiles return on hit or after reaching max range. Reloading retrieves shot projectiles. Max 5 fired projectiles. Infinite ammo. Can overheat.

name: Dark Matter Gauntlets
description: The gauntlets harness the power of a neutron star and a black hole. When merged  cosmic forces are unleashed.

name: Decayed Claws
description: Makeshift claws fashioned from decayed root and rusted metal.

name: Deceit
description: A pinpoint accurate split-barreled rifle that fires two penetrating rails. High base damage  but cannot score Weakspot hits. Charge to fire.

name: Double Barrel
description: A double-barrel shotgun which can deal massive damage at close range with back to back shots.

name: Dreamcatcher
description: A magical stave capable of harnessing the energy of nearby enemies.

name: Edge of the Forest
description: An elegant  yet light blade  designed to bring beauty to bloodshed. Unstoppable in the hands of a master swordsman.

name: Enigma
description: Fires an electrical stream that jumps to nearby targets within 7.5m  dealing 30% reduced damage per jump. Applies OVERLOADED.

name: Feral Judgement
description: A pair of gauntlets with sharp bone blades that strike with vicious speed and velocity.

name: Ford's Scattergun
description: An incredibly powerful 12 gauge shotgun with a wide spread. High damage  slow reload.

name: Gas Giant
description: Dealing damage unleashes the dormant Toxic Gas within the head. When infused  Basic Attacks apply CORRODED for 5s.

name: Genesis
description: N'Erudian tool with low energy reserves that generates energy bolts. Charging turbines generates additional projectiles. Max 5.

name: Godsplitter
description: An expertly balanced blade that is the product of advanced Fae metallurgy. Cannot score Weakspot hits without its Mod behavior.

name: Harvester Scythe
description: Harvester automaton limb fitted with a plasma torch. The system breach of a Drzyr phantom initiated jettisoned protocols  trapping strange properties within the makeshift weapon.

name: Hellfire
description: Spews flames that apply BURNING which deals 300 → 900 FIRE damage over 10 seconds.

name: Hero's Sword
description: An ancient  quick  and versatile blade suited for many situations. Contains a hidden power.

name: Huntmaster M1
description: A high-powered long range bolt-action rifle with exceptional accuracy and a 2.5x magnification scope.

name: Huntress Spear
description: A battle-worn spear worthy of the finest hunters. Charge Melee Attacks apply CORROSION dealing 100 ACID damage over 5s.

name: Iron Greatsword
description: A giant broadsword made from flattened railroad tracks. Dozens of ridges cut in the side for causing irreparable damage.

name: Knuckle Dusters
description: Steel knuckles with rusty sawblade tips  designed to boost Unarmed damage.

name: Krell Axe
description: Infused with Krell Shock magic  can be thrown if the wielder has stamina. Axe will magically reappear in hand. Charge to throw.

name: Labyrinth Staff
description: Basic Strikes generate 10% additional Mod Power. Charge Attacks perform an AOE which strikes all enemies within 2m  dealing 75 Damage. AOE Damage generates 50% additional Mod Power.

name: MP60-R
description: A small-caliber sub-machine gun best suited for close range skirmishes.

name: Merciless
description: Fires tooth-like flechettes. When weapon reticle is fully compressed  flechettes apply 200 → 600 BLEED damage over 10s.

name: Meridian
description: Fires grenades that explode on contact with enemies and deal AOE damage within 4m. Dormant grenades eventually explode and can be shot to detonate early. Cannot Weakspot.

name: Mirage
description: The mace whirs as if living harmonics hold its shape. When swung  a breath of sand tethers to the rock crown for extended reach and lethal momentum.

name: Monarch
description: An once-beautiful weapon  rumored to corrupt its wielder with absolute power.

name: Monolith
description: Fires concentrated sand. Sustained primary fire and Sandstorm hits apply EXPOSED for 3s. Max 15s.  EXPOSED: Target receives 15% additional damage from all sources.

name: Monorail
description: A mysterious relic that fires super-dense penetrating rails. Can be charged to unleash violent levels of energy. Warning: Overcharging may have catastrophic results.

name: Nebula
description: Fires a stream of superhot ACID gas which applies CORRODED effect  dealing 300 - 900 CORROSIVE Damage over 10s. Killing targets CORRODED by Nebula spawns a gas cloud which applies its on-hit effect. Gas clouds lasts 2s and can be refreshed.

name: Nightfall
description: A device forged of pure evil. Fires hardened bone shards at a brisk rate dealing bonus stagger. Semi-automatic with a medium kick.

name: Nightshade
description: Fast striking claws with a high Critical Hit chance. Neutral Dodge grants the power of Lifesteal.

name: Ornate Blade
description: An intricately-forged elongated sword. Designed to keep stronger enemies at bay  while remaining light enough for agile maneuvers.

name: Ornate Flail
description: An intricately-forged flail with uniquely designed airways. Allows smaller wielders to get the weapon up to speed much quicker.

name: Plasma Cutter
description: An energy-based cutting tool that increases damage when focused on a target. Can overheat.

name: Polygun
description: ERROR: Unable to load description.ERROR: Unable to load description.

name: Pulse Rifle
description: An extremely accurate  high-tech pulse rifle which shoots quick three-round bursts.

name: Rebellion Spear
description: A spear perfect for staying at a distance. Has excellent range  great recovery  and focused direct damage for one on one combat.

name: Red Doe Staff
description: A magical stave rumored to contain a healing spirit within. Strikes with wide swings.

name: Redeemer
description: Fires a tight grouping of World Stone slugs. Hits rip away a small portion of the enemy  sending it to another realm.  Incapable of standard Mod Generation.

name: Repair Tool
description: Fires a stream of nanomachines  dealing damage to enemies or healing allies for 3% of their Max Health per second. The nano-tech also restores N'Erudian Energy to Turrets and Drones.

name: Repeater Pistol
description: An accurate semi-automatic pistol that can rapidly fire small-caliber bullets.

name: Repulsor
description: Converted from experimental Dreamer tech  ideal for mid-range combat. Weapon becomes more accurate the longer AIM is held.

name: Ritualist Scythe
description: An evil-fueled reaping tool that deals additional damage to suffering targets.

name: Royal Broadsword
description: Standard issue Greatsword for the Empress' Royal Guards. Razor-sharp edges  extremely heavy  yet perfectly balanced.

name: Royal Hunting Bow
description: A lightweight  easy handling bow designed for hunting. High critical chance  bonus damage on Weakspot hits  and a low sound profile. Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

name: Rune Pistol
description: A pistol infused with mysterious Fae magic. Rapidly fires 3-round bursts of energy. Trigger can be held to continuously fire.

name: Rupture Cannon
description: A mid-range Pistol Shotgun with a brisk fire rate and medium recoil. Slower reload.

name: Rusted Claws
description: A pair of old-canine training bracers converted into deadly claws. Used for slashing and ripping.

name: Rusty Lever Action
description: A well-worn lever-action rifle.

name: Rusty Repeater
description: An old antique pistol.

name: Sagittarius
description: A high-powered Bow which deals bonus damage to Weakspots. Can be charged for increased effect. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

name: Savior
description: An old Fusion Rifle refactored to store and violently release energy in each shot. Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

name: Scrap Hammer
description: A large  heavy warhammer cobbled together from engine components. It is a slow-but-devastating weapon meant to destroy anything it hits.

name: Scrap Hatchet
description: A common chopping tool that has been repurposed for combat. Rapidly cycles attacks from right to left. Charge attacks strike twice.

name: Scrap Staff
description: A staff made from old plumbing parts used for controlling wide swaths in front of the wielder.

name: Service Pistol
description: A standard issue military spec sidearm known for its reliability and accuracy.

name: Shovel
description: It's a shovel.

name: Silverback Model 500
description: A powerful hand cannon with a low capacity cylinder. High damage and a heavy kick.

name: Smolder
description: A scorched blade imbued with FIRE.

name: Sorrow
description: The last vestiges of a fallen sister  this mystical crossbow pistol has the ability to recall its bolts to heal the wielder.

name: Sparkfire Shotgun
description: Fires incendiary shells that apply BURNING which deals 30 → 90 FIRE damage over 3 seconds.

name: Spectral Blade
description: A super-heated laser sword with an infinitely sharp edge. Perfect for cutting... anything.

name: Sporebloom
description: An exceptionally powerful single-shot weapon that deals bonus stagger damage. Must reload after each round fired.

name: Star Shot
description: Fires a fast moving projectile which explodes on contact. Explosion has no damage falloff.

name: Starkiller
description: Alien rifle that shoots high velocity rails which penetrate enemies. Equipped with a 2.5x magnification scope. Double Tap AIM to Scope.

name: Steel Flail
description: An unorthodox weapon meant to convert momentum into destruction. Some attacks can continuously chain overhead swings.

name: Steel Katana
description: An old piece of steel with serrations cut into one side. Pipe handle provides limited grip.

name: Steel Scythe
description: A ruthless threshing device.

name: Steel Spear
description: A spear perfect for staying at range with quick  focused attacks. High  single-target damage.

name: Steel Sword
description: A long  sharp blade hammered out of vehicle leaf springs. Well-rounded for most situations.

name: Stonebreaker
description: A massive Greatsword which contains the harnessed magic of a corrupted Guardian. Can summon small shockwaves.

name: Sureshot
description: A high-caliber single-shot hunting pistol that inflicts heavy damage at mid to long range.

name: Tech 22
description: A suppressed small-caliber automatic pistol with medium magazine capacity and a high fire rate.

name: Thorn
description: Fires homing needles which deal 5 - 15 Explosive Damage after sticking for 2s. When 5  needles are stuck in a target at once  BLOWBACK triggers  dealing 50 - 150 Explosive Damage instead.

name: Trinity Crossbow
description: A powerful Pan crossbow designed for mid-range combat. Fires 3 bolts at a time.

name: Twisted Arbalest
description: A strange device which fires a bouncing Energy Disc that can hit up to 5 enemies in close proximity. Damage is reduced with each bounce.

name: Vice Grips
description: A N'Erudian tool converted into a ruthless ripping device. High raw damage.

name: Western Classic
description: A classic six-shooter. Tough. Dependable.

name: Widowmaker
description: A powerful single-shot sniper rifle with excellent range and pinpoint accuracy. Comes with a 3x scope. Tap SCOPE to toggle.

name: World's Edge
description: A glowing Greatsword forged from shards of a shattered Worldstone. Charge attacks cast waves.

name: Wrangler 1860
description: A well-rounded lever-action rifle effective at most ranges  hampered only by a slow reload.

name: Wrathbringer
description: A massive hammer infused with the souls of deceased Dran. Its dormant power can be awakened by taking damage.

name: XMG57 "Bonesaw"
description: An experimental infantry support weapon used for prolonged suppressive fire. High capacity  long reload  and prone to overheating. Becomes more accurate while holding down the trigger.
